svg.title: What saving the settings tests
svg.desc: Saving first checks every setting; an invalid one is not saved. When scheduled synchronization is on or a token was entered, saving runs the connection checklist. When Paperless can't be reached, refuses the token or doesn't let the account view documents, or the target user can't create files in the base folder, the settings are not saved; the page says why and, when only the schedule asked for the test, that turning it off saves the settings. When only a permission of one module is missing, such as the one for the tags, the settings are saved, and the checklist names the permission to grant. With the schedule off and no new token, the settings are stored without a test, so that an administrator can pause a synchronization that fails.
